description: Standard modes from the 2015 Airservices table. Order in this file is the final tie-break. Capacities are the owner's own estimates, set on 24-10-2026, not official figures (SY-7): 20 movements per hour for SODPROPS, 07AD and 25AD; 30 for the modes that cross runways (25A16D, 34A25D, 34AD25, 07A16D); no limit for 34AD and 16AD. Runway uses marked long-haul only in the source are listed like any other use; the engine ignores the aircraft class (OD-19).

modes.description: Simultaneous opposite direction parallel runway operations; enabled by the owner, 23-10-2026, for use at any time of day

approachLadders.description: Approach type pilots are told to expect, from cloud base (lowest layer of any cover, or vertical visibility) and visibility, for the modes that run parallel approaches. Rows are checked from the top and the first match wins.
approachLadders.source: YSSY operations guide, approach-type table (owner decision 26-10-2026, OD-83)

rows.description: Cloud base above 3000 ft and visibility 5000 m or more: independent visual approaches.
Cloud base 2000 to 3000 ft inclusive and visibility 5000 m or more: instrument approach, then independent visual approach.
rows.hoverText: INSTR APCH THEN INDEP VISUAL APCH
